notes:
talk2me no longer quits when you allow the microphone or Accessibility during the tour. The crash came from a status line that went blank while macOS was reading the window for its permission prompt, VoiceOver or another app that reads the screen. Every line that is read aloud as it changes is now safe to go blank.
Picking Deny when macOS asks about the Keychain no longer leaves your shortcut dead until you restart talk2me.
An unexpected error inside the window no longer closes talk2me; it is noted in the diagnostic log and the app keeps going.
